items.alt: A bearded US official gestures beside a chained green-card door marked PERM PAUSED as Indian tech workers wait; a sign notes H-1B status remains unchanged.
A TCS office tower climbs green steps toward a rising market arrow with an AI robot and rupee sack, while broken red stock charts lie below.
Opposition leaders line up to meet President Murmu at 8 pm, while a crowd stays behind barricades holding a newspaper attributed to CJP that says 10,000 were detained.
